title: Pollyanna
author: Eleanor H. Porter
short_summary: After her parents die, young Pollyanna goes to live with her strict Aunt Polly in a small New England town. Rather than feel sorry for herself, Pollyanna plays the "glad game" her father taught her — finding something to be glad about in every situation, no matter how hard. Her relentless cheerfulness slowly begins to change the people around her, including her stern aunt.
extended_summary:
After her parents die, young Pollyanna goes to live with her strict Aunt Polly in a small New England town. Rather than feel sorry for herself, Pollyanna plays the "glad game" her father taught her — finding something to be glad about in every situation, no matter how hard. Her relentless cheerfulness slowly begins to change the people around her, including her stern aunt.

When Pollyanna is badly injured and can no longer walk, the entire town — moved by all the kindness she has shown them — comes together to lift her spirits, playing the glad game right back at her. Even in her darkest moment, the town's collective gratitude helps Pollyanna hold onto hope, and Aunt Polly finally learns to open her heart the way her niece always has.
